title: A prime containing an ideal contains a minimal prime over that ideal
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq R$ an ideal and $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal with $I\subseteq\mathfrak p$. Then there is a prime ideal $\mathfrak q$ with $I\subseteq\mathfrak q\subseteq\mathfrak p$ which is minimal over $I$, i.e. no prime ideal $\mathfrak q'$ satisfies $I\subseteq\mathfrak q'\subsetneq\mathfrak q$. For $I=0$: every prime ideal of $R$ contains a minimal prime ideal of $R$ (a prime ideal containing no strictly smaller prime ideal).
